Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered customer experiences.
Experience in selling to SMBs, and experience in a multi-product company with shared platforms and real cross-team dependencies
Strong experimentation instincts and the judgment to know when a flat result means iterate and when it means stop.

title: Chief of Staff to Chief Strategy Officer

requirements.quote: Act as a high-leverage surrogate for the CSO, attending key meetings and customer discussions on her behalf when she requires added executive coverage.
Partner closely with the CSO as a strategic sounding board, leveraging data and sharp business instincts to simplify complex problems and keep executive focus on high-impact priorities.
Translate high-level strategic vision, enterprise narratives, and complex technical data into executive and client-ready slide decks and comprehensive prep materials for high-stakes meetings.

Relevant Experience: 10+ years of combined experience across Investment Banking or Management Consulting and Big Tech, holding roles such as Technical Assistant, Product Manager, Business Development, Chief of Staff or similar.

Executive Presence & Surrogate Authority: Proven track record of stepping into high-stakes meetings on behalf of executives, building instant credibility with C-suite stakeholders, enterprise customers, and board members.
Master-Level Communication & Writing Skills: Exceptional written and verbal skills; proven ability to write across multiple formats.

Technical Aptitude & Product Fluency: Deep technical foundation with the ability to quickly grasp and translate complex technical concepts and products, effectively collaborating with engineering and technical product leaders.
